openParts: Only the current 57 adapted definition roles are represented; original declared helper/unit types and upgrade classes are not a fully playable original roster.
Missing source visuals in the complete native class progression remain explicit renderer fallbacks. An original mesh in a different era is not claimed as the native appearance of the missing era.
Western cache variants dominate; the other native cultural sets and female citizen geometry are not generally selectable or bound.

Native deaths, takeoff/landing, animation variants, text-key events, particle children, billboard/controller systems and complete material/rendering parity are not implemented by this geometry export.
The morph exporter samples real KF tracks, but its linear/slerp interpolation does not reproduce all native quadratic tangents or event timing.
Existing native far LODs are used only when present and lower in triangle count; no procedural reduction is substituted.

validation.originalModelsNodeAudit: Passed after the new exports and bindings; includes source hashes, mesh buffers, PNGs, normalization, far LOD and clip schema.
validation.runtimeNumbers: Fortress ID56 adds seven native stat stages and garrison metadata; pre-existing field values of IDs0..55 remain identical to the previous dataset. No byte-equivalent Rust or WASM claim.

unitImportProof.scope: Fortress added at stable EE2 ID56, seven native stages. All field values previously present for IDs0..55 are independently compared with the prior extracted Mac package; newly sourced garrison metadata is separate. Rust changed intentionally; no byte-equivalence claim.

evidence.scope: Read-only existing Ghidra engine project, no full reanalysis; independent PE string-table validation. This resolves the earlier UnitType+A0 population naming uncertainty for the analyzed engine.

chain.meaning: For each property-table row, resolve its name through00a36060 and store returned descriptor+0x18 as the corresponding property offset.
Read the property through the popCount resolved offset, follow native inheritance resolution, and write the resulting integer to UnitType+0xA0.

Garrison required-slots getter returns1 for Leaders, otherwise reads UnitType+0xA0. Together with the named-property binder this identifies ordinary required slots as native popCount, rather than merely estimating it from unit size.

header.supports: m_popCount is population consumption; m_popCapacity is population granted. Naming supports, but does not replace, the executable binding.

limits: This establishes the analyzed engine build; it does not prove every unofficial patch DLL override.
The Leaders special case remains explicit. No playable Leader definition is added by this feature.
Imported gameplay roles still include explicit adapters; source-class population does not make every adapted role an exact original unit.
evidence.independentReview: Confirmed independently by the engine and source-audit agents against the raw PE bytes and the exported assembly.

garrisonSlotBinding.scope: Eligible bound native source classes use inherited DDF popCount, except Leaders use one. The semantic binding is verified on the explicitly identified EnabledUP15Units executable; numeric DDF values remain from the selected base db.zip. No general patch/VFS precedence is inferred.

limitations: Leaders use exactly one slot. No playable bound source class currently declares Leaders. No general unofficial-patch/VFS ordering is inferred.
